questions.question: Complete the saying: "A stitch in time saves _____"
questions.explanation: The full proverb is "A stitch in time saves nine" — fixing a small problem early prevents nine more.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "The early bird catches the _____"
questions.explanation: Rising early gives you the first opportunity — the bird that is up first gets the worm.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Don't count your chickens before they _____"
questions.explanation: Don't assume success before it actually happens — an egg is not yet a chicken.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Actions speak louder than _____"
questions.explanation: What you do matters more than what you say you will do.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Better late than _____"
questions.explanation: Doing something late is still better than not doing it at all.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Birds of a feather _____"
questions.explanation: People with similar interests, character, or background tend to group together.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Every cloud has a silver _____"
questions.explanation: Even bad situations have something hopeful in them — the silver lining behind the cloud.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Honesty is the best _____"
questions.explanation: The full proverb is "Honesty is the best policy" — telling the truth is always wisest in the long run.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Look before you _____"
questions.explanation: Think carefully before you act on something important.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Practice makes _____"
questions.explanation: Repeatedly doing something makes you better at it — the practice eventually produces mastery.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "The pen is mightier than the _____"
questions.explanation: Writing and ideas can change the world more powerfully than violence.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Two heads are better than _____"
questions.explanation: Two people thinking together solve problems better than one person alone.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "When in Rome, do as the _____ do"
questions.explanation: Adapt to the customs and behaviour of the place you are in.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "You can't judge a book by its _____"
questions.explanation: Don't form an opinion of someone or something based only on outward appearance.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "All that glitters is not _____"
questions.explanation: Something that looks attractive or valuable is not always what it appears to be.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Rome wasn't built in a _____"
questions.explanation: Great things take time to accomplish; don't rush important work.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Necessity is the mother of _____"
questions.explanation: When you really need something, you find a way to make it — need drives creativity.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Where there's a will, there's a _____"
questions.explanation: If you are determined enough, you will find a way to achieve your goal.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Strike while the iron is _____"
questions.explanation: Act while the opportunity is still available — like a blacksmith working hot iron.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "The grass is always greener on the other _____"
questions.explanation: People always think others have it better than they do — an illusion of greener grass.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Absence makes the heart grow _____"
questions.explanation: Being away from someone you love makes you appreciate and miss them more.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Too many cooks spoil the _____"
questions.explanation: Too many people trying to manage the same task usually ruin the result.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "A rolling stone gathers no _____"
questions.explanation: Someone who keeps moving or changing does not accumulate lasting connections or wealth.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Charity begins at _____"
questions.explanation: Take care of your own family and community before trying to help others.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Prevention is better than _____"
questions.explanation: It's easier to stop something from happening than to fix it after it has happened.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Once bitten, twice _____"
questions.explanation: After being hurt or cheated once, a person becomes cautious the second time.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "The pot calling the kettle _____"
questions.explanation: Accusing someone of a fault you have yourself — both pot and kettle are blackened by fire.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "Blood is thicker than _____"
questions.explanation: Family bonds are stronger than other relationships.

questions.question: Complete the Nigerian saying: "When the moon is shining, the cripple becomes hungry for a _____"
questions.explanation: From Chinua Achebe's "Things Fall Apart" — a favourable situation can motivate even the least likely person.

questions.question: Complete the saying: "It takes a village to raise a _____"
questions.explanation: An African proverb — raising a child well requires the effort of the whole community.
